Progress & settings

Cards, exercise results, checklists and drafts are saved in this browser only. Last backup: never.

Each browser and device keeps its own progress. The website and the copy on your computer also count as separate, even in the same browser. Export a backup to keep your work or move it: restore the file wherever you want to continue. / Hver browser og enhed gemmer sine egne fremskridt. Tag en sikkerhedskopi for at gemme eller flytte dem.

Each card is completed once. Each answered exercise leaves the queue, regardless of correctness. New material uses new IDs and enters the queue automatically. Completion is not a measure of mastery. / Hvert kort og hver opgave gennemføres én gang. Nyt materiale tilføjes automatisk; færdige aktiviteter gentages ikke.

Pronunciation uses a Danish voice from your browser or device if one is installed. The app does not record your voice or grade writing automatically. Dark mode follows your device setting.
